units.source_text: 那封信展开在桌子上，但紫姬装作并不想看的模样。

en.t: The letter lay unfolded on the table, but Lady Murasaki pretended that she did not wish to look at it.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣说：“你硬装不要看，却又偷看。

en.t: Genji, the Minister of the Interior, said, "You force yourself to act as if you will not look, yet you steal glances all the same.

units.source_text: 你那眼色才教我不安呢。”

en.t: That look in your eyes is what makes me uneasy."

units.source_text: 说着莞尔而笑，脸上娇憨之色可掬。

en.t: As he said this, he smiled gently, his face full of charming innocence.

units.source_text: 他靠近紫姬身旁，对她言道：“不瞒你说，她已经生下一个可爱的女孩，可见前世宿缘不浅。

en.t: He drew close to Lady Murasaki and said to her, "To tell you the truth, she has already given birth to a lovely little girl, which shows that our bond from a former life was no shallow one.

units.source_text: 然而这母亲身份低微，我公然把这孩子当作女儿抚养，又恐惹人议论。

en.t: But the mother is of low rank, and if I openly raise the child as my daughter, I fear it will cause gossip.

units.source_text: 因此我很烦恼。

en.t: That is why I am so troubled.

units.source_text: 请你体谅我，代我想个办法，一切由你做主吧。

en.t: Please understand my situation, think of some way to help me, and let everything be decided by you.

units.source_text: 你道如何是好？

en.t: What do you think would be best?

units.source_text: 接她到这里来由你抚育，好不好？

en.t: Would it be all right to bring her here and have you raise her?

units.source_text: 现在已是蛭子之年，这无辜的孩子，我不忍抛弃她。

en.t: She is already in her third year now, and I cannot bear to abandon this innocent child.

units.source_text: 我想给她那小小的腰身上穿一条裙子，如果你不嫌亵渎，请你替她打结，好么？”

en.t: I would like to put a skirt around that tiny waist of hers; if you do not think it improper, would you tie it for her?"

units.source_text: 紫姬答道：“你如此不了解我，竟出我意料之外。

en.t: Lady Murasaki answered, "I never expected that you understood me so little.

units.source_text: 你倘如此，我也只得不管你的事了。

en.t: If that is how you are, then I will simply have to stop concerning myself with your affairs.

units.source_text: 你该知道，我最喜欢天真烂漫的孩子。

en.t: You should know that I love innocent, carefree children more than anything.

units.source_text: 这孩子当这年龄，该是何等可爱呵！”

en.t: At that age, how adorable this child must be!"

units.source_text: 她脸上微微露出笑容。

en.t: A faint smile appeared on her face.

units.source_text: 原来紫姬生性爱好小儿，她很想取得这女孩，抱在手里抚育她。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had always loved little children, and she longed to take this girl in, hold her in her arms, and raise her herself.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣心中迟疑不决：究竟如何是好？

en.t: Genji, the Minister of the Interior, wavered in his heart: what, after all, should he do?

units.source_text: 真个迎接她来此么？

en.t: Should he really bring her here?
